question: What is the total net revenue in the data?
sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS total_net_revenue FROM fact_sales

question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS total_orders FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many different products were sold at least once?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT product_key) AS unique_products FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many registered customers placed at least one order?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_key) AS registered_customers FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE NOT c.is_guest AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount) / count(DISTINCT invoice_no), 2) AS aov FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many units were sold in total?
sql: SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT is_cancelled THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales

question: How many cancellation invoices are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS cancellation_invoices FROM fact_sales f WHERE f.is_cancelled

question: What is the total value of all cancellations?
sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS total_cancellations_value FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = true

question: On how many different days did the shop receive at least one order?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT date_key) AS days FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: What are the gross sales before cancellations?
sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: Which 5 countries generated the highest net revenue?
sql: SELECT k.country_name, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) GROUP BY k.country_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY p.product_key, p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 products by net revenue?
sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: From how many countries did the shop receive orders?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT k.country_name) AS countries FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled

question: How much net revenue came from guest checkouts?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS guest_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key WHERE c.is_guest = true

question: Who are the 5 registered customers with the highest net revenue? Give their customer ids.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE NOT c.is_guest AND NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders came from Germany?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) WHERE k.country_name = 'Germany' AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: What net revenue did the product 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER' generate?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.stock_code = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER'

question: How many products were ordered by customers from more than 20 different countries?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.product_key) AS products FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) JOIN (SELECT customer_key FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY customer_key HAVING count(DISTINCT country_key) > 20) c20 ON f.customer_key = c20.customer_key

question: What is the average net revenue per registered customer?
sql: SELECT round(avg(net_revenue), 2) AS avg_net_revenue_per_registered_customer FROM (SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key <> 0 GROUP BY customer_key) subquery

question: What was the net revenue in each year?
sql: SELECT d.year, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: What was the net revenue of the best month of 2011?
sql: SELECT d.month, d.month_name, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the net revenue in November 2011?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 AND d.month = 11

question: What was the net revenue in each quarter of 2011?
sql: SELECT d.quarter, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: By how many percent did net revenue grow from 2010 to 2011?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.year = 2010 THEN f.line_amount END) AS a, sum(CASE WHEN d.year = 2011 THEN f.line_amount END) AS b FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key)) SELECT round(100 * (b / a - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM m

question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.is_weekend = TRUE AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: How many orders were placed on the busiest day of the week?
sql: SELECT d.day_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY d.day_name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the net revenue in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.date >= (SELECT max(d2.date) FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.date_key <= (SELECT max(date_key) FROM fact_sales)) - INTERVAL 30 DAY

question: How many new customers did the shop get in 2011?
sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT f.customer_key, MIN(f.invoice_ts) AS first_ts FROM fact_sales f WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND f.customer_key <> 0 GROUP BY f.customer_key) SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM firsts WHERE YEAR(first_ts) = 2011 AND first_ts >= '2011-01-01' AND first_ts < '2012-01-01'

question: By how much did net revenue change from September 2011 to October 2011 (October minus September)?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.month = 9 THEN f.line_amount END) AS sep_revenue, sum(CASE WHEN d.month = 10 THEN f.line_amount END) AS oct_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key)) SELECT round(100 * (oct_revenue / sep_revenue - 1), 1) AS revenue_change_pct FROM m

question: What is the average delivery time of an order?
sql: SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch from f2.invoice_ts - f1.invoice_ts) / 3600 / 24), 2) AS avg_delivery_time FROM fact_sales f1 JOIN fact_sales f2 ON f1.invoice_no = f2.invoice_no WHERE f1.quantity > 0 AND f2.quantity < 0 AND NOT f1.is_cancelled AND NOT f2.is_cancelled

question: Which salesperson closed the most orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the most common reason customers give for a return?
sql: SELECT d.description AS reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product d ON f.product_key = d.product_key WHERE f.is_cancelled AND f.line_amount < 0 GROUP BY d.description ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
